verdict.rationale: Numeral documents recording transactions through its API (POST /tax/transactions) and native integrations that "record completed transactions back to Numeral for filing and nexus monitoring." Pricing also mentions connecting sales channels. However, the evidence never documents historical backfill or bulk import. Transactions apparently require a prior calculation, which complicates importing sales processed elsewhere, and the specific processors and storefronts supported are not named. missing for 10: documented historical/bulk backfill import, a named list of processor and storefront connectors, evidence that multi-channel imports are consolidated into filings, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, transactions from every channel can be imported — API backfills and connector syncs from other processors and storefronts — so filings cover my whole business, not just one integration

citations.quote: Each integration handles tax calculation at checkout or invoice time and records completed transactions back to Numeral for filing and nexus monitoring.
Record a transaction with a POST to `/tax/transactions`
You can connect your sales channels and receive a free nexus study
After your sale clears, you’ll log the transaction with us so we can file your tax return.
